capabilities: transcribe handwritten PDFs to Markdown via Gemini
generate a titled note with summary, headings, tables, and LaTeX math
tag action items with a configurable tag
create an OCR-enhanced searchable PDF copy
customize note title format and output folder
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires the user's own Gemini API key; the selected PDF is uploaded to Google's API during conversion.
problem: Handwritten PDF notes are hard to search, skim, or reuse in Obsidian, and copying their content into notes manually is tedious.

relations.evidence: Send the selected PDF to Gemini for handwriting recognition.
This plugin bundles pdf-lib under the MIT license

summary: AI converter that turns handwritten PDFs into formatted Markdown notes using Gemini handwriting recognition, with an optional searchable OCR PDF copy.
